payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and annotations used to identify non-standard pronunciation, including the transcription of mispronunciations and the use of phonetic alignment techniques.

claims.text: Non-standard pronunciation is identified through annotations for mispronunciations, poor intelligibility, and other speech disfluencies in transcriptions.
Phonetic alignment techniques are used to measure the quality of speech generation and identify discrepancies in pronunciation.
The lack of standardized orthography in Mapudungun leads to varied orthographic conventions, which can indicate non-standard pronunciations.
